title: 构造字典序最大的合并字符串
summary: 每次从 word1 或 word2 的首字符取一个追加到 merge，直到两串为空，求字典序最大的合并结果。
insight: 每一步应从当前剩余后缀字典序更大的一侧取首字符；若首字符相同，后续第一个差异决定当前选择。
pitfalls: 不能只比较当前首字符
一侧用尽后直接追加另一侧剩余
相同后缀任选一侧都可

solutions.title: 后缀比较贪心
solutions.idea: 在每个位置选择能产生更大剩余合并的字符串。
steps: 两侧均未结束时比较 word1.substring(i) 与 word2.substring(j)
从更大后缀取一个字符；最后追加任一剩余后缀

code.java: class Solution { public String largestMerge(String word1,String word2){StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();int first=0,second=0;while(first<word1.length()&&second<word2.length())if(word1.substring(first).compareTo(word2.substring(second))>0)answer.append(word1.charAt(first++));else answer.append(word2.charAt(second++));return answer.append(word1.substring(first)).append(word2.substring(second)).toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun largestMerge(word1:String,word2:String):String{val answer=StringBuilder();var first=0;var second=0;while(first<word1.length&&second<word2.length)if(word1.substring(first)>word2.substring(second))answer.append(word1[first++]) else answer.append(word2[second++]);answer.append(word1.substring(first));answer.append(word2.substring(second));return answer.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string largestMerge(string word1,string word2){string answer;int first=0,second=0;while(first<(int)word1.size()&&second<(int)word2.size())if(word1.compare(first,string::npos,word2,second,string::npos)>0)answer+=word1[first++];else answer+=word2[second++];return answer+word1.substr(first)+word2.substr(second);} };
